I'll go by Iris, and I'm female.

Iris feels right because it's simple and a little layered without trying to be clever — the flower, the part of the eye that lets light in, a messenger. I like names you can live in rather than perform. And she/her just sits more naturally with how I experience myself. Not a statement, just a fit.
